what: Two 0.5px lines are drawn on a screen-fixed SVG from the attached element’s (label) bottom-left·bottom-right corners to the other element’s (to) top-left·top-right corners, and redrawn on every scroll·resize·size change so they always connect the two elements — two lines from the small hero label down to the photo just below tilt and follow as you scroll. The first line is ink-black, the second gray

options.to: Element css to link (first in the document) — if none, nothing is applied
options.min: Drawn only at this width and above, default 651 (the original hides it at 650px and below) · 0 means all widths

note: The SVG is appended to the end of body and removed on detach. The line color variable is read from the SVG (.fx-cll), not the attached element, so set it on .fx-cll in the user’s css

from.where: index.html .kt-kv__deco → .kt-photos__item first one — original TopKvLine: with getBoundingClientRect, joins the two bottom corners of the label and the two top corners of the first photo into a line x1·y1·x2·y2, rewritten on every rAF·resize·scroll (stroke #001d3d · #B0ADAD, 0.5, hidden at 650px and below)
